Face & Neck Serum A targeted serum gel with roller application designed to lift the appearance of the jaw, cheek and neck for a more defined looking facial and neck contour.
Powered by 4D BIO-SHAPELIFT™: A powerful complex to visibly lift and firm the appearance of the facial contours.
AQUA/WATER/EAU, PROPANEDIOL, GLYCERIN, CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE, SILICA, BACILLUS FERMENT, CYNARA SCOLYMUS (ARTICHOKE) LEAF EXTRACT, DEXTRAN, EPIGALLOCATECHIN GALLATE, EPIGALLOCATECHIN GALLATYL GLUCOSIDE, ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN, HYDROLYZED SODIUM HYALURONATE, ISOMALT, LACTIC ACID, LECITHIN, LONICERA CAPRIFOLIUM (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, LONICERA JAPONICA (HONEYSUCKLE) FLOWER EXTRACT, LYCIUM BARBARUM CALLUS CULTURE EXTRACT, PINUS NIGRA BARK EXTRACT*, PINUS NIGRA BUD/NEEDLE EXTRACT*, POLYACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER-6, SODIUM CARBOXYMETHYL BETA-GLUCAN, SODIUM HYALURONATE, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, SPILANTHES ACMELLA FLOWER EXTRACT, TRIFLUOROACETYL TRIPEPTIDE-2, XANTHAN GUM, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PHENOXYETHANOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE, SODIUM BENZOATE, PARFUM/FRAGRANCE.
*KORRES BLACK PINE EXTRACTS
1198 Black Pine is a perennial tree that has thrived in the Mediterranean for over 3,5 million years. Nature’s chameleon, it can withstand high mountain altitudes, conditions of both extreme cold and scorching heat, even highly polluted urban environments. Under the guidance of the Directorate of Forests of Grevena, we source by-products of timber production from Black Pine that gracefully rises on Pindus Mountains, that would else be discarded.
40 mL / 1.35 FL. OZ. The Black Pine collection "bio-mimics" and recovers the initial symmetry of our face, in 14 days : lifted facial appearance, improved appearance of wrinkles, enhanced elasticity, improved texture, full cheekbones, and a younger-looking neck, noticeable improvement of facial sagging, especially around the jawline. Powerful formulas featuring delightful textures and 100% natural origin fragrance, to lift, firm and redefine the appearance of facial contours, with clinical tested efficacy.
Lift & Rich Hydration All skin types 4D BIO-SHAPELIFT™ 0 Black Pine Pindus Through a 100% zero-waste process, we attain high quality extracts using exclusively natural solvents. Solid residue is composted to end up back into the soil as organic fertilizer. The Black Pine extract was used for the first time in a cosmetic formula by KORRES. We were the ones to discover and introduce this powerful Greek antiaging ingredient to the global cosmetic ingredient bible (WINCI ).
We have been studying the powers of perennial trees for over a decade. The aim is to decode their powerful defence mechanisms and develop them into cosmetic ingredients in the pursuit of a robust, healthy-looking skin. In this quest, Black Pine is yet another KORRES discovery. Polyphenol-rich Black Pine extract improves the appearance of wrinkles and skin firmness. The KORRES Black Pine collection is fuelled with the innovative 4D Bio-ShapeLift™ technology. A potent complex that delivers lifted appearance, revealing an enhanced facial contour in the cheek, chin and jawline area. Almost in defiance of gravity laws, face symmetry returns with the power of the 4D BIO-SHAPELIFT™ technology. This complex combines a 3 amino acid peptide and an active of marine biotechnology lifted from freezing ocean depths. The 3 amino acid peptide improves the appearance of visible signs of aging, enhances skin elasticity and contributes to the “revival” of the facial v-shape. The marine biotechnology active helps "recharge" skin, providing defence against sagging. It grants a unique lifting effect, combined with firm and long-lastingly bright skin.
Form, function and elegance, in our language; minimalist and modest, in full harmony with what makes natural beauty distinct. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council). The ‘tree-tick’ symbol indicates that the paper has been sustainably sourced, ensuring forest growth, contributing to an overall ecosystem balance.Form, function and elegance, in our language; minimalist and modest, in full harmony with what makes natural beauty distinct. 90% of our packaging across all our product lines is recyclable.Paper packaging is FSC certified (Forest Stewardship Council). Ισχυρές φόρμουλες για στοχευμένη δράση σύσφιγξης, ανόρθωσης περιγράμματος και lifting, με κλινικά αποδεδειγμένη δράση. Άρωμα 100% φυσικής προέλευσης και βελούδινες υφές.
